   'verdict': 'pass', 'defect_categories': [], 'correction': ''
  },
  {
   'requirement_id': 'assumption-integrity',

   'evidence': 'The target specifies only u(m)>=0 and, for each real z, existence of delta with |delta|<=u(m) and r(z)=z(1+delta).    'verdict': 'pass', 'defect_categories': [], 'correction': ''
  }
